_about: Public-domain Geremia Bonomelli (1831-1914), Bishop of Cremona, in English translation for the Word Hoard: the New Series of Homilies for the Whole Year (four volumes, 1909) and Christian Mysteries, discourses for the great feasts (four volumes, 1910), both translated by Thomas Sebastian Byrne, and On Religious Worship and Some Defects in Popular Devotions (1907), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
